1.explanation: The heart of the bug is in Link.js: the Link function component destructures all props into a catch-all (`...other`) but never pulls out the `inline` boolean or adds the corresponding modifier class `${prefix}--link--inline`. As a result, passing `inline` to <Link> does nothing. To fix this you need to update the Link component to include `inline` in the signature, add a conditional modifier in the `classnames` call, and declare `inline: PropTypes.bool` in the propTypes. No other files need changing to correct the inline variant behavior.
1.bug_scenario: The spec calls for an “inline” variant of the <Link> component that underlines text by default (with the modifier class `--link--inline`), but when you pass the inline prop (e.g. `<Link inline>`), no inline modifier class is applied and the text isn’t styled correctly. In other words, out of the box the Link component renders only with the base class (`--link`) and ignores the inline prop, so the inline underlined style never appears.

2.explanation: The core Link component in Link.js is responsible for rendering the <a> tag and calculating its class names. The tests and spec expect an inline prop to add `${prefix}--link--inline` to the class list, but the current implementation only destructures children, className, and href and ignores inline. To fix the bug, Link needs to destructure inline from props and include it in the classnames call (e.g. using classnames(`${prefix}--link`, { [`${prefix}--link--inline`]: inline }, className)). This change will satisfy both the visual spec and the existing test in Link-test.js that checks for the inline modifier class.
2.bug_scenario: The spec image shows an “inline link” variant that by default should render with an underline and, when the inline prop is passed, include the modifier class `${prefix}--link--inline`. In the provided example, <Link inline> ...</Link> in a paragraph should receive the inline underline styling, but the component currently does not apply the inline modifier class and therefore fails to render the underline as specified.
